static_traits.name: 赵丹
static_traits.family_status: Close relationship with husband and family; plays bingo with her husband every Wednesday
static_traits.social_status: 与丈夫和家人关系密切，整体支持性Good，但尚not yet就此类感受与他们沟通
static_traits.medical_history: 左膝有金属填充，without显著躯体疾病；既往not yet接受心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性Good、能进行自我Reflection；情绪略低落但态度积极、合作度高；对失败敏感并有羞耻感，愿意尝试认知重构与作业

basic_info.main_problem: 昨晚在宾果游戏中失利后感到自己是个失败者，并产生“应该永远not再玩”的想法。
basic_info.core_demands: These thoughts and feelings affect my participation in activities I once enjoyed and damage my self-esteem, so I hope through counseling to reduce catastrophizing and self-labeling thinking and restore the willingness to participate in activities.
growth_experiences: 来访者童年时期很少在游戏中获胜，这使她逐渐形成“我有问题/I am a failure”的自我感受；每当失败场景出现，这些早期的挫败体验就被激活，Reinforcement了对自我价值的负面判断，并在成年后延续到当前的休闲活动中。

special_situations.event: Losing in last night's bingo game (played with my husband every Wednesday)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我输掉游戏，就证明I am a failure，应当停止参与以免再次受挫
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避再次玩宾果及其他可能失败的活动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我就是失败者，我应该永远not再玩了

special_situations.event: 在其他游戏或活动中失利
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a single failure occurs, it means I am a failure overall
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Labels oneself a 'failure' and reduces attempts to avoid the shame brought by failure

special_situations.event: 考虑是否向丈夫或家人表达自己的感受
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我分享这些感受，do not人会认为我小题大做或很可笑
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not与家人讨论，选择独自承受情绪
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我过度反应、太幼稚

special_situations.event: 回想童年时期很少赢得游戏
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 童年多次失败说明我这个人本质上有问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少参与竞争性活动，以避免再次验证“I am a failure”的信念
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一直都是输家，这说明我有问题

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被接纳与被认可，not以输赢来定义自我价值
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被视为失败者而遭到评判或轻视，体验羞耻与Impaired self-esteem
defense_goal: 通过回避可能失败的活动以及not表达脆弱感受来降低被评判的风险、维持自尊的脆弱平衡

object_relations.object_representation: “他人会评判我、觉得我反应过度或可笑”

object_relations.self_representation: 需要支持与理解的伴侣
object_relations.object_representation: 支持、理解但not yet被充分寻求的丈夫与家人
object_relations.linking_affect: 被理解的期待、温暖与not确定

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests sharing feelings with the husband or family, or discussing re-engaging in activities
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to believe that others will negatively evaluate their emotional reactions (transference: projecting inner self-criticism toward others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in an empathic and normalizing tone, gently clarifying and exploring evidence, inviting them to try limited sharing and attend to actual feedback.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the meaning of a failure or its impact on self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将一次失败体验视为对整体自我价值的全盘negate（好坏without法整合）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use连续体与灰度探索的Questioning，温和挑战极端化理解，强调多维证据与具体情境。

manifestations: 以输赢结果为条件地限定自我与选择（“我应该永远not再玩”）
Views failure as a decisive verdict on self-worth, reducing autonomous participation and attempts
outcomes: 回避休闲活动、乐趣减少
选择范围缩窄、对失败情境的恐惧加重

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以“输就等于失败者”“我应该not再玩”为绝对规则约束自己
用他人的可能评价作为衡量自我价值的标准

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: not向支持性的丈夫和家人表达感受，将期待的支持转而由自己消化
把对失败的愤懑与羞耻转向自我批评

positive_force: 与丈夫和家人关系亲密、具有支持资源
能够识do not并讨论负性自动思维，愿意尝试认知重构与行为实验
Realizes bingo is just an entertainment activity and begins to form a more balanced perspective
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent，倾向用一次失败定义整体自我
Highly sensitive to others' evaluations, tending toward mind reading and self-labeling
回避失败情境，缩减活动参与度，Reinforcement负性信念循环

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding participating in originally enjoyed activities after failure (such as bingo)
antecedent: 想到可能再次失败或被评判
target_behavior.core_reason: 童年屡次在游戏中失利的经历被激活，形成“I am a failure”的核心信念，以失败定义自我价值并产生羞耻感
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败带来的羞耻与Anxiety，短期降低not适情绪
target_behavior.consequence: 娱乐与社交活动减少、Decreased enjoyment of life，Impaired self-esteem并维持负性信念

target_behavior.behavior: 失败后出现反复的负性自我对话（如“I am a failure”“我总会输”）
antecedent: 近期在宾果或其他活动中失利
回想童年少有胜利的经历
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次或几次失败过度概括为稳定的自我特质，Reinforcement灾难化与非黑即白认知
target_behavior.function: 通过自我标签化为not确定体验提供简单解释，暂时获得控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood、Decreased motivation，进一步增加回避并削弱参与感
